messages:
anya: Quick sync  opening a small PR to consolidate 429 / timeout / context-limit guidance in errref. Found stale links and older SDK snippets that don't parse Retry-After.

sam: Nice. Can you include a short PR checklist (link-check, snippets validate, smoke logs)?

doc-bot: Link scan: 3 broken anchors under /errref, 2 snippets missing validate markers. Full log: /tmp/errref-5067.log

mike: Ill update the Go snippet. Prefer context.WithTimeout + defer cancel and a tiny prompt-trim helper.

jess: I'll rewrite the fallback UX to separate model-variant vs capacity/region fallbacks. Also add a short note on streaming disconnects (use jittered backoff).

anya: Plan: swap go/ts/curl snippets to use Retry-After + X-RW-Retry-Policy headers, add minimal Node smoke test asserting 429 handling, and include a Dedicated migration footnote. Will tag reviewers when PR is up (~30m).

sam: Ping me on PR and Ill fast-track snippet validation. Add label `docs:snippets-changed` per CI.

anya: Will do. Draft curl I'll include:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"short"}' "https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate?model=redwood-vicuna-13b"
```
Node smoke test (tiny):
```js
const r = await fetch(u,h)
if (r.status===429){const ra=r.headers.get('retry-after')||'1'; await sleep(Number(ra)*1000)}
```

jess: :thumbsup: I'll preflight copy when PR lands.

anya: Thanks everyone  PR link and artifacts will be posted here.
